t: From `grep` to `ripgrep`: A Command-Line Refactoring Workflow
s: This article details a developer's transition from GUI-based code searching to mastering command-line tools, specifically `grep`, `git grep`, and `ripgrep` (`rg`), for efficient project refactoring and search. It highlights `ripgrep`'s superior performance, ease of use, and integration with `.gitignore` as a 'life-changing' improvement.
